answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 145501 Country: India Title: I want to ask you if I have a wet dream but I am sure that I don't release semen but madhi comes out so ghusl is fardh on me? During ghusl or wudhu if some dirty water falls on body parts so I have to make ghusl (wudhu) again or use some pure water on that? Question: I want to ask you if I have a wet dream but I am sure that I don't release semen but madhi comes out so ghusl is fardh on me? During ghusl or wudhu if some dirty water falls on body parts so I have to make ghusl (wudhu) again or use some pure water on that? Answer ID: 145501 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 81/112/L=2/1438) (1) Yes, in this case ghusl shall be wajib on you provided you remember the dream. (2) There is no need of doing ghusl again, only the impure place should be washed. However, fresh wudhu shall be required provided the impure water flows out of its place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
